ACTUAL COVERAGE
First fully read CURRENT RU .github\copilot-instructions.md (394 lines), .github\instructions\content-structure.instructions.md (253), docs\translation-methodology.md (169), docs\content-format-reference.md (107): all 923 lines. Fully read all three CURRENT RU-root accuracy/consistency/comprehension reviewer rubrics, using RU file-RAW domains, not EN copies/header hashes.
Read both boundary sections and every Q001–Q117 proposal. All required teaching reads succeeded: 20 complete EN/RU primary pairs=40 bodies; 98 complete contextual pairs=196; 55 whole EN-only comparisons; four whole EN-only articles: 295 unique bodies. Articles are runtimeProvider=false, without RU counterparts. Read all 353 complete ordered entity-expanded official objects/attributes/restrictions in 19 windows, not archive RAW slices. Read all 1387 fresh CURRENT candidate caption/reading/quiz rows in 11 windows, NOT 1387 whole lessons. Used bindings-003/pool-002, not obsolete pool001/prior071 counts.
Actually consumed all three historical public payloads: Kotobank 18150 characters, Oggi 3262, Kotobank continuation 488; total 21900. Not fresh network/RAW HTML. Complete Daijisen heading/derivation/three senses and Oggi's dismissive easy-to-handle/deceive/defeat account were read.
Extra scope: whole CURRENT RU words\多い.md and words\事故.md, complete official entries 1407460/1313850. Totals: 297 unique teaching bodies, 355 official objects; rereads not added. No mandatory output was missing/truncated or replaced by receipts.
Execution caveat: the tool automatically spooled one oversized OPTIONAL helper-source response into Local\Temp. I did not use/count that spool; a bounded relevant parser-source selection succeeded. No explicit file writes, author edits, tests/builds, Git mutation/fetch, delegation or agent messages.

C1 — FACTUAL/SOURCE FIDELITY
No consequential new lesson-level factual error established. Japanese examples/readings/forms/classifications/kanji metadata and source distinctions were preserved; available navigation versus unavailable optional wrappers was distinguished.
Critical boundaries: 凄い 1374550.4 is a colloquial HEADWORD adverb; 1397300.2 instead specifies derived すばらしく. 全然 affirmative use is colloquial; 最も independently includes extremely, not every superlative=very. なるほど has independent adverb sense 2. ええ/good is Kansai prenominal sense 5, not ordinary yes. 変/change and 珍しい/new/splendid are separate senses, not compounds. 気/fragrance is き sense 10, not suffix げ/ぎ. なかなか 1599420.4 is Nの, not unrestricted な-adjective grammar. External evidence supports the retained 非道 derivation/ちょろい nuance, not unsupported frequency/history extensions.

C2 — SCOPE/CLOSURE/AMBIGUITY
Examined the exact 20 roots and actual providers; all five original source-pair providers are accepted/selected, no closure-only roots. Guards were not treated as prior approval. Two consequential missing direct dispositions remain:

072-F01 — MEDIUM — words\おかしい.md, quiz_exclusions.
No direct おかしい–違う edge exists either way. Actual 違う caption: “отличаться; быть неверным.” Current おかしい explicitly teaches “неправильный” and incorrect statements/calculations. Official 1190860.2/.3 and 1158880.2 independently support wrong/incorrect, without compound/inflection lifting. “Быть неверным” cannot simply be presumed false for bare おかしい. Remedy: add direct protection in the new lesson, or supply a construction-aware quiz restriction genuinely removing the collision; no baseline edit needed.

072-F02 — MEDIUM — words\凄い.md, quiz_exclusions.
多い, actual pool row 534 “много; многочисленный,” has no direct edge to 凄い. Official 1374550.3 explicitly includes vast numbers; additionally read 1407460.1/.2 supplies many/large quantity. Whole RU 多い confirms quantity, not physical size. This is the direct quantity question already considered for Q021/たくさん, not protection inherited through it. Remedy: explicitly adjudicate/protect 凄い–多い under the same sense-level policy, or document construction-aware exclusion from quiz eligibility. Dictionary inclusion alone does not establish modern frequency/necessity.

Additional K-level questions, NOT automatic guard requirements: しっかり–結構 (1594400.3 sufficiently/well; 1254760.2/.4 satisfactory/fairly well; actual caption includes “достаточно”); 変–事故 (1510640.4 incident/accident; 1313850.1 and actual “авария; несчастный случай”). Modern bare-word/construction suitability remains UNVERIFIED. Shared speed alone also does not establish interchangeable whole captions for どんどん–すっと.

K qualifications:
Q007/Q076: positive Nの sense, not current “довольно; никак не.” Q015's separate affirmative adverb limb supports D; negative delay is excluded.
Q031: affirmative colloquial only, not negation. Q032: extremely, not unrestricted superlative. Q033: bounded どうも degree/collocations, not thanks/greeting. Q034: independent adverb 2 really/quite/indeed; no demonstrated collision with “понятно; вот как” or unrestricted degree substitution.
Q037: permission/go-ahead, not every request. Q038: OK acknowledgment versus approval, not general yes. Q039: Kansai prenominal good only.
Q042: honest/proper, not seriousness generally. Q044: easy/light, not weight caption. Q047: easy/quick, not early. Q050: suitable, not quantity/correspondence generally.
Q060: noun change versus changing verb, not strange in an unrestricted infinitive. Q080: no/stop interjections, not all reluctance.
Q086: independently well/sufficiently, not merely slow. Q087/Q088: sufficiency with different constructions, not every infinitive/being on time. Q091: firm/solid family, not universal hardness/spelling interchangeability.
Q097: clarity/definiteness versus certainty, not automatic truth. Q098: sensory clarity, not beauty/arbitrary cleanliness. Q101/Q106: quick, not early. Q102: sustained/successive change, not equal speed/universal gradualness. Q108: selected relief/refreshment, not every calm/refreshed state.
Q113: popular/widespread state versus popularity noun. Q115/Q116: figurative atmospheric mood, not arbitrary bodily sensations/every person's mental state.

D qualifications: Q012's praise/degree limbs remain separate. Q022–Q030 rely on actual 凄い headword-adverb evidence, never derived すばらしく. Q036 is permission, not ability/readiness. Q045 is brevity; Q049 tangled unpleasant relations, not liquid. Q057/Q062 do not equate rarity with abnormality; Q058/Q059 use independent noun change. Q071 uses novel/new; Q072–Q077's fine/splendid senses do NOT establish modern suitability/frequency. Q079 concerns the interjection. Q082–Q096 preserve sufficiency/completion/firmness/reliability/thoroughness/effort distinctions, not effort=success. Q099 is frankness, not spatial direction. Q103–Q107 preserve direction/timing/speed/quietness distinctions. Q109–Q112 do not make every crowd/strong thing thriving. Q114 has actual literal fragrance/figurative evidence, without suffix lifting; Q117 is figurative atmosphere, not literal air.

Five original source pairs, independently judged:
すばらしい–立派 D: 1397300.1/1551790.1–2, splendid/impressive praise.
凄い–すばらしい D: 1374550.2/1397300.1, positive admiration, not every negative extreme.
よろしい–いい D: 1224880.1/2820690.1,.4, good/acceptable/permission.
よろしい–大丈夫 D: 1224880.1/1414150.1,.3, all right/acceptability; refusal contextual.
よろしい–結構 D: 1224880.1/1254760.1–2, fine/satisfactory, not every refusal/degree use.

C3 — RUSSIAN
All 20 are substantive, complete Russian lessons, not title-only translations/English placeholders. Examples, cautions and comparisons were naturally recast while preserving Japanese rules. No consequential new Russian-language defect established; unchanged contextual material is not repaired/reaccepted by this assessment.

DISPOSITION/BOUNDARIES
C2 remains unresolved because of F01/F02: NOT CLEAN, learner acceptance, or a second/focused review. D/K does not prove ordinary modern quiz NECESSITY/FREQUENCY, broader suitability, or global/future uniqueness; these remain UNVERIFIED without actual supporting evidence.
